media.title: Rork's AI App Store Reviewer predicts likely rejection issues before submission

title: Run an AI App Store Review Before Submission
summary: Rork introduces an AI App Store Reviewer that predicts likely App Store rejections and fixes underlying issues before submission, reporting 87% accuracy on the company's internal benchmark. An iOS team can run this as a preflight check while treating its score as an unverified vendor claim and preserving human review.
takeaway: Add an automated App Store policy preflight before submission, but keep its findings advisory until a reviewer confirms each proposed fix against current Apple guidance and the app's actual behavior.
